Name: FashionMirrorCatalog
Author: Moux303
Description:
FashionMirrorCatalog
FashionMirrorCatalog adds a visual wardrobe catalog to the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror, allowing you to browse your installed appearances by category, preview them directly on your farmer, and easily manage saved outfits and outfit presets.
Instead of searching through appearance names one by one, you can browse hairstyles, clothing, accessories, and other appearances visually. You can also browse outfit previews, organize outfits into groups, and customize the catalog layout to suit your preferences.
In short: turn your Fashion Sense Hand Mirror into a visual wardrobe and outfit catalog.
[b]Version: 0.3.15[/b]
Main Features
[heading]Visual Browsing[/heading]
The appearance catalog supports the following Fashion Sense appearance types:
[list]
[*]Hair[/*]
[*]Accessories[/*]
[*]Hats[/*]
[*]Body[/*]
[*]Shirts[/*]
[*]Pants[/*]
[*]Sleeves[/*]
[*]Shoes[/*]
[/list]Each appearance is displayed in a visual grid, with the number of items per page adjusting to the available catalog space and layout.
[heading]Character Previews[/heading]
Each appearance is displayed as a character preview rather than a generic item icon.
The preview uses your current farmer's appearance, Fashion Sense colors, and other equipped appearances. It also follows your farmer's current facing direction.
The currently equipped appearance is marked with a green dot. Clicking an appearance will immediately equip it.
You can also locate the currently equipped appearance in the catalog. If your current appearance is not recognized as a Fashion Sense appearance, the catalog will indicate that no matching appearance was found.
[heading]Outfit Catalog[/heading]
Browse saved outfits and outfit presets through visual character previews.
Each outfit is displayed on a preview card, allowing you to see how it looks on your farmer before choosing it.
The outfit catalog also supports:
[list]
[*][b]Custom outfit display names and authors:[/b] Customize the names and author information displayed in the catalog without changing the original outfit data.[/*]
[*][b]Favorites:[/b] Mark outfits as favorites and filter the catalog to show only your favorited outfits.[/*]
[*][b]Search:[/b] Search for outfits by name, author, or source.[/*]
[*][b]Outfit information:[/b] Hover over an outfit to view its name, author, and assigned groups.[/*]
[*][b]Outfit management:[/b] Open an outfit's management panel to edit its display information and organize it into groups.[/*]
[/list][heading]Outfit Groups[/heading]
Organize outfits into custom groups to make large collections easier to browse.
[list]
[*][b]Create groups:[/b] Create new groups and optionally assign them to the selected outfit.[/*]
[*][b]Assign multiple groups:[/b] Assign an outfit to multiple groups, or remove its group assignments to leave it ungrouped.[/*]
[*][b]Rename and delete groups:[/b] Manage existing groups from the group manager.[/*]
[*][b]Filter by group:[/b] Select a group to display only the outfits assigned to it.[/*]
[*][b]Customize displayed groups:[/b] Choose which groups appear in the group sidebar, either by automatically displaying recent groups or by manually pinning your preferred groups.[/*]
[*][b]Scrollable group lists:[/b] Browse your groups even when the list is too long to fit in the available space.[/*]
[/list]These tools make it easier to organize outfit collections by theme, character, occasion, or any other system you prefer.
[heading]Accessories[/heading]
FashionMirrorCatalog supports all three Fashion Sense accessory slots.
The selected accessory slot stays synchronized with the original Fashion Sense Hand Mirror, allowing you to browse and equip accessories for slots 1, 2, and 3 directly from the catalog.
[heading]Appearance Favorites[/heading]
Mark individual appearances as favorites using the checkbox in the bottom-right corner of each appearance tile.
Favorited appearances are marked with a yellow square in the checkbox. Hover over the checkbox to see whether clicking it will add or remove the appearance from your favorites.
You can filter the catalog to display only your favorited appearances, making frequently used styles easier to find.
[heading]Search[/heading]
Search for specific appearances by entering part of their name or ID and pressing Enter.
The outfit catalog also supports searching by outfit name, author, or source.
These search options make it easier to find the appearance or outfit you want without browsing through every page manually.
[heading]Pagination and Dynamic Layout[/heading]
The catalog layout is no longer limited to a fixed 3×3 grid.
[list]
[*][b]Adjustable preview size:[/b] Use sliders to adjust the width and height of preview tiles relative to the catalog.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic grid layout:[/b] The number of rows and columns adjusts automatically according to the preview size and available space.[/*]
[*][b]Flexible page capacity:[/b] The number of appearances or outfits displayed per page changes with the layout.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple navigation options:[/b] Navigate between pages using the arrow buttons or mouse wheel, or enter a page number and press Enter to jump directly to it.[/*]
[/list]The catalog displays the current page and the total number of items in the selected category or outfit collection.
[heading]Customizable Interface Size[/heading]
Adjust the catalog's overall width and height to suit your preferences.
You can reset the dimensions to their initial values with a single click. You can also set your preferred initial dimensions, allowing the catalog to start at your chosen size.
Combined with the adjustable preview size, these settings let you tailor the catalog to your screen and browsing preferences.
[heading]Hand Mirror Integration[/heading]
FashionMirrorCatalog works alongside the original Fashion Sense Hand Mirror rather than replacing it.
The selected appearance category is synchronized between the catalog and the original Hand Mirror. Changes made in either interface will be reflected in the other.
The original Hand Mirror remains usable outside the catalog panel.
Installation
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download FashionMirrorCatalog and extract it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The mod will automatically detect Fashion Sense and integrate with its Hand Mirror.
Compatibility
FashionMirrorCatalog is designed to work with Fashion Sense appearance packs without requiring individual compatibility patches.
The catalog uses Stardew Valley's standard menu textures, so compatible UI reskins can also affect its appearance.
[b]Tested Environment:[/b] The author has tested this mod on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.5.0 or later, and Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later. Compatibility with other operating systems, game versions, or software versions has not been verified.
